cleaver.details: Loot from Lann Tarv at Moonrise Towers.

gold-pendant.details: On the upstairs table beside the staircase in Philgrave’s Mansion.

heavy-crossbow.details: Loot from Murmath near the entrance to Grymforge (X: -626, Y: 373).

hide-armour.details: Traders using the Armour Trader Table stock this armour up to level 4.

longbow.details: Loot from Zarys in the Zhentarim Basement beneath Waukeen’s Rest.

rapier.details: Loot the Abducted Nobleman on the Ravaged Beach (X: 230, Y: 271).

sahuagin-spear.details: Loot from a Sahuagin, including the ones at the docks east of Philgrave’s Mansion.
